power.title: Power
power.rebootMessage: The machine runs its own restart command. Every connection to it — this one included — goes down with it, and whatever is running there is stopped.
power.shutdownMessage: The machine runs its own shutdown command. Every connection to it — this one included — goes down with it, and whatever is running there is stopped.
power.issued: The command was issued. The machine may disconnect at any moment.
